title: Gear-Driven BoomBox Frequency Mixer
description: A mechanical BoomBox is powered by an interlocking gear system. The user manipulates gear ratios, torque inputs, and frequency channels to mix audio frequencies visualized as colored energy rings around the BoomBox. Energy is conserved across channels — boosting one frequency steals energy from others — and a full undo/redo history tracks every adjustment.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load BoomBox.glb centered at origin scaled to fit view, and gears.glb positioned to its left as a mechanical drive system scaled proportionally. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,1.5,3) looking at origin, with ambient light (0.4) and two directional lights for dramatic effect on a dark background (#111). SIMULATION: The gears drive the BoomBox. Animate gear meshes rotating continuously; rotation speed is controlled by a 'Torque' slider (0-100). The BoomBox has 3 frequency channels (Bass=red, Mid=green, Treble=blue) each with a slider (0-100). Implement energy conservation: total energy across all 3 channels is always fixed at 150 units. When one slider increases, the others proportionally decrease to maintain the sum. Display 3 colored torus rings orbiting the BoomBox whose scale and emissive intensity map to their channel value. Gear rotation speed equals Torque * 0.01; the torus orbit speed is gear_speed * channel_value * 0.001. Add a 'Coupling Mode' toggle button that switches between 'Proportional' redistribution (default) and 'Nearest Neighbor' mode where only the adjacent channel absorbs the delta. Add a 'Brake' button that sets Torque to 0 and freezes all animation. Implement full undo/redo: every slider change or button press pushes state onto an undo stack. Provide Undo (Ctrl+Z) and Redo (Ctrl+Y) buttons and keyboard shortcuts. Display a HUD overlay showing current Torque, channel values, coupling mode, and undo stack depth. The interaction steps are: adjust Torque, set Bass, set Mid, set Treble, toggle coupling mode, adjust Bass again observing nearest-neighbor, press Brake, undo Brake, redo Brake, adjust Torque to new value, undo back to initial state. All UI as HTML overlays with clean dark-themed styling.
